contexts.text: Say thou art my sister () = intellectual truth. Explained. AC 1495.
Abraham again calls his wife his sister.
This is my sister () = rational truth; for sister = intellectual rational truth. AC 2523.
That rational truth is sister. Explained.
Sister = what is rational.
Sarah as a sister = rational truth.
That from being his sister she became his wife = that by means of rationality spiritual truth was conjoined with the Celestial.
Brother, in the Word, = the affection of good; and sister, the affection of truth. AC 3132. AC 3303.
The affection of truth is here represented by Rebekah his sister ().
Rebekah their sister () = the affection of truth Divine. Sister = truth.
Our sister be thou for thousands of myriads () = the fructification of the affection of truth to infinity.
(Isaac) said, She is my sister () = rational truth. Explained. AC 3394.
The reason this was done three times, is that by sister is signified rational truth; whereas wife = Divine truth; and this was called rational to prevent its adulteration. Explained.
The sister of Nebaioth () = the affection of celestial truth...
Sister = intellectual or rational truth.
I have wrestled with my sister (). Explained.
Sister = truth; here () the truth of faith.
His sister stood afar off to know what would be done to him () = the truth of the Church far from it, and advertence.
Under Miriam, see this reference.
The Lord's sisters () = those in truths from this good.
